item.title: Hubble 1.4.2
item.description:
Hubble 1.4.2
Hubble 1.4.2: Quartz connection fixes and CyanView RCP controls
- Improve Evertz Quartz startup, keepalives, reconnection, and repeated route requests using the CyanView connection flow. - Load router names on request so optional discovery does not prevent routing. - Add CyanView RCP Select Camera, Record Camera (Toggle), and Record Group ALL (Toggle), with feedback off by default. - Preserve CyanView RCP connections and actions in workspace imports, exports, and spreadsheet transfers.
